test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Malleable
solution:
The correct answer is **Stiff.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most** **appropriate antonym of the given word is Stiff.
 
• **Malleable** means the **a****bility to be hammered or forced into shape without breaking or shattering** (a metal or other material).
 
• The most appropriate antonyms of the given words would be** ****hard, intractable, Stiff** etc.
 
• Thus the correct answer is **Stiff.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Flexible, Variable and Resilient all are not antonyms of the given word Malleable.
 
• **Flexible** meaning **able to bend without breaking easily.**
 
• **Variable **means are **a variable or changeable aspect, trait, or factor**.
 
• **Resilient **means (of a human or animal) is able to endure or swiftly recover from trying circumstances.
